differences.what: the upper storeys, the pavilion's attic, the mansard, its dormer and the south stack: the 1902 remodel left them as the Chicagology prints draw them
differences.how: T-3562: the camera is fitted to them (3.3 px rms over eleven points and the flank's cornice line); the build's upper storeys, already matched to both Chicagology prints, fall on the picture's within a few pixels

differences.what: the one-storey stone bay across the front's middle (x 205-290 px, v 1.24-7.04 m, its face about 1.2 m proud): three tall transomed lights in its front (v 2.11-3.20, 3.73-4.71 and 5.22-6.33 m; 2.05-4.17 m over grade), one in its south cheek, two barred basement lights under the outer ones
differences.how: T-3562: built as a K08 projection 5.8 m wide and 1.2 m proud on the front (front_bay), a basement storey to 1.8 m and a principal storey of three transomed lights to 4.36 m, its lights within about 0.1 m of the picture's; the corner bay, the stoop and the pedimented door it replaced are gone

differences.what: the bay's top: a row of modillions under a moulded crown at 4.36-5.04 m and a plain blocking course to about 5.7 m, under the second storey's sills
differences.how: T-3562: built as K08's corbel table (a course on blocks, 4.36-4.79 m) under a plain stone storey to 5.4 m and the bay's flat top to 5.69 m, held 0.15 m under the second storey's sills over it; the crown's moulding and the modillions' carving are under the bar on this print, and the flat top's thin edge renders in the bay's painted tin where the print's coping is stone

differences.what: an iron railing on a stone ledge across the bay's front at its basement's head (the ledge at about 1.46 m, the rail about 0.85 m over it)
differences.how: T-3562: a squared floor balcony on the bay (K08 floor_balcony squared, rail_fabric iron, options this ticket added): a 0.2 m stone ledge 0.35 m out across 5.58 m, an iron rail on it run round its corners back to the wall

differences.what: the entrance: a small one-storey stone block north of the house's north wall (v -1.95 to 0.46 m, its face about 0.2 m before the front), capped about 3.06 m over grade, with a round-arched doorway at grade in it (v -1.33 to 0.0, its crown about 2.15 m) under a square label
differences.how: T-3562: built as a K08 projection set out 1.95 m past the front's north corner (set_out_m, run 0.96 m back along the flank to the stair projection, set_out_back_m) carrying the K01 door: a round-headed double door at one riser over grade (entrance_floor_m 0.15, opening_m 1.33 by 2.0 m) under its voussoir ring and keystone, the arch turned in the block's face (K01 options this ticket added: a door past the front's corner, carried by such a block)

differences.what: the square label round the arch's head and the block's moulded cap
differences.how: the arch's ring and keystone stand where the label does; the cap is K10's moulded stone cornice, 0.2-0.3 m deeper than the print's thin slab

differences.what: the doorway reads black in the print: an open vestibule arch, the door unseen behind it
differences.how: K07's deep-arch door stands 0.95 m back in its reveal; behind the railing it reads as a dark opening at this size

differences.what: the tall iron railing on a stone curb along the street line, its spears about 1.8-1.9 m over grade, run from the north lot line to the south
differences.how: T-3562: K11's spear railing on its curb, its top rail raised to 1.5 m over the curb (fence_rail_top_m), its gates hung on slender iron posts; the old low coping is gone

differences.what: where the railing's gates stand: the print shows no gate against the shadowed run
differences.how: a pair of leaves on the walk to the arched door and the side passage's gate at its mouth (v -4.35 to -3.0 m), reconstructed (docs/LIBERTIES.md)

differences.what: the neighbours, the street trees and the street
differences.how: the review render draws the house alone

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236).
